"""ic9_04_e2e (implementation stage C, C2 second fix commit (staged tree a6ce8a0e, parent 0cbee197), round 1; task 2 of
the invocation; my ic8_04_e2e.py rewritten for the changed code and the changed test). Data Auditor's own script:
nothing of the Executor is imported here.

Runs the Executor's test tests/test_run_pilot.py::test_test_evaluate_end_to_end_once once as a driver subprocess (C1
ruling item 5; throw-away clone with a bare remote, synthetic TEST rows written by the test itself, random tiny models,
require_gpu and the device check replaced by the fixture; no TEST data, no weights), with my pass-through trace plugin
(ic9_04_trace_plugin.py) and pytest's --basetemp in my scratch directory. My expectations are printed BEFORE the run;
after it this script compares the trace, the bare remote's history (git only), the clone and the work directory with
them.

The test now makes four run_test_evaluate calls (runs 0-3):
  run 0  base model replaced by a different tiny model (not N's weights of the step 3 record): refused before the
         marker (ProtocolStop without a stop code): no record, no commit;
  run 1  one checkpoint file changed: refused before the marker, no record;
  run 2  the evaluation (the test replaces before_run with a list append first);
  run 3  TEST already evaluated: begin raises TestAlreadyEvaluated; NOW (MAJOR 3 / IC8-M1): no record, no commit,
         TestAlreadyEvaluated raised; the test asserts the remote tip is unchanged.
My ST7 look-ahead for the fixture's step 2 timing (mean_step_s 0.1, a_factor 1, dev_evaluation_seconds 1, load_s 1,
hash_s 0.1, save_s 0.1, reload_s 0.1, file_hash_s 0.1), my model of this round (see ic9_04e): load_s (N) + 15 x reload_s
(the checkpoints) + 16 x DEV 1 x 3/2 (TEST / DEV questions per fact) + 17 state hashes x 0.1 + 15 files x 0.1
= 1 + 1.5 + 24 + 1.7 + 1.5 = 29.7 s.

Modes (faults injected by my plugin into run 2):
  normal                  the test as written; pytest exit 0.
  stop_after_marker       ProtocolStop(None, BLOCKED) at the 3rd evaluate_model(split="test"): begun_by_this_process
                          True -> experiment record (BLOCKED, test_begun True) committed and pushed; returns (False,
                          'BLOCKED'); the test fails at its own assertion (pytest exit 1).
  crash_after_marker      RuntimeError at the same point: record BLOCKED "crash after the TEST marker: RuntimeError(...)",
                          pushed, RuntimeError raised again (pytest exit 1).
  interrupt_after_marker  (supplementary, CG20) KeyboardInterrupt at the same point: record BLOCKED "crash after the TEST
                          marker: KeyboardInterrupt(...)", pushed, KeyboardInterrupt raised again (pytest interrupted,
                          exit 2).
  st7_before_begin        (supplementary, CG5) stops.Stop("ST7", BLOCKED) from before_run(look-ahead) in run 2, before
                          the base model is loaded: not begun, stop code ST7 -> experiment record (BLOCKED, stop ST7,
                          test_begun False) committed and pushed; no marker, nothing evaluated; returns (False,
                          'BLOCKED'); the test fails at looks[0] (pytest exit 1).
usage: python -I -B ic9_04_e2e.py <repo_root> <venv_python> <inputs_dir> <scratch_dir (created, must not exist)> <mode>
"""
import os
import sys
sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
import json
import shlex
import subprocess
import time
from ia_common import run

RES = "metrix/e1-pilot/results"
MARKER = RES + "/test_evaluation_marker.json"
RESULT = RES + "/test_evaluation_result.json"
STEP2, STEP3 = RES + "/step2_record.json", RES + "/step3_record.json"
FREEZE, GATE0 = RES + "/selection_freeze_record.json", RES + "/gate0_record.json"
TEST_ID = "metrix/e1-pilot/tests/test_run_pilot.py::test_test_evaluate_end_to_end_once"
SELECTED = {"F": "F3", "L": "L2", "A": "A5"}
FIXTURE_TIMING = {"mean_step_s": 0.1, "a_factor": 1.0, "dev_evaluation_seconds": 1.0, "load_s": 1.0, "hash_s": 0.1,
                  "save_s": 0.1, "reload_s": 0.1, "file_hash_s": 0.1}
MY_LOOKAHEAD = 1.0 + 15 * 0.1 + 16 * 1.0 * 3 / 2 + 17 * 0.1 + 15 * 0.1
TEXT_NEEDLES = ("Synthetic question", "not a TEST row", "synthetic window", "SYNTHETIC_T", "synthetic-")
ROW_KEYS = {"question", "ids", "generated_ids", "output", "normalized", "doc_id", "scores", "prediction", "top2_gap",
            "answer_index"}
MODES = ("normal", "stop_after_marker", "crash_after_marker", "interrupt_after_marker", "st7_before_begin")
AFTER_MARKER = ("stop_after_marker", "crash_after_marker", "interrupt_after_marker")


def git(d, *args):
    r = subprocess.run(["git", "-C", str(d), *args], capture_output=True, text=True,
                       env=dict(os.environ, GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS="0"))
    return r.stdout.strip() if r.returncode == 0 else None


def my_models():
    seeds = (101, 202, 303)
    names = ["N"]
    for arm in ("F", "L", "A"):
        names += ["%s-%s-seed%d" % (arm, SELECTED[arm], s) for s in seeds]
    for arm in ("S", "Y"):
        names += ["%s-%s-seed%d" % (arm, SELECTED["F"], s) for s in seeds]
    return names


def walk_keys(obj, out):
    if isinstance(obj, dict):
        for k, v in obj.items():
            out.add(k)
            walk_keys(v, out)
    elif isinstance(obj, list):
        for v in obj:
            walk_keys(v, out)
    return out


def predictions(mode, models):
    pre = ("check_preconditions once, start_checks('test-evaluate') once, committed reads freeze < Gate 0 < step 2 < step 3 "
           "before the checkpoint loop, the 15 checkpoint files (set = models[1:]) hashed, test_evaluation_seconds once "
           "with the fixture's timing returning %.6f s, before_run(next_seconds=%.6f) once, base_model once, "
           "T.state_sha256 once (the base model) -- all before begin" % (MY_LOOKAHEAD, MY_LOOKAHEAD))
    p = ["models TEST evaluates (my list, set): %s" % sorted(models),
         "run 0 (base model replaced by the test with a different tiny model): " + pre + "; that hash != N's of the "
         "committed step 3 record -> ProtocolStop without a stop code; begun_by_this_process -> False; no begin, no "
         "evaluation, no final_record, no commit_paths; returns (False, 'BLOCKED'); no marker",
         "run 1 (models[1]'s checkpoint file changed by the test): check_preconditions once, start_checks once, the "
         "committed freeze / Gate 0 / step 2 / step 3 records read, exactly 1 checkpoint file hashed (that one); no "
         "test_evaluation_seconds, no before_run, no base_model, no state hash, no begin, no evaluation, no commit_paths, "
         "no final_record; begun_by_this_process -> False; returns (False, 'BLOCKED'); no marker"]
    begin_state = ("begin entered once with the base hash == step 3 N; at its entry the Pilot's begin_called True, "
                   "marker_before_begin False, no marker file in the clone's working tree")
    if mode == "normal":
        p += ["run 2: " + pre + "; that hash == step 3 N; " + begin_state + "; then 16 x (before_run(0.0), "
              "evaluate_model(split=test) with one state hash and one claim) in the marker's model order, no DEV "
              "evaluation; compute_test_values, judge_test, report_comparisons(test) once each after the last evaluation; "
              "finish (commit_paths [result] inside); begun_by_this_process not called; final_record('test-evaluate', "
              "'PIPELINE_NOT_QUALIFIED', stop None) writing experiment_record_test-evaluate_<start>.json/.txt, "
              "commit_paths [those two]; returns (True, 'PIPELINE_NOT_QUALIFIED')",
              "run 3: " + pre + "; begin entered once with begin_called True, marker_before_begin True (the pulled marker "
              "is in the working tree), raises TestAlreadyEvaluated; no evaluation; begun_by_this_process not called; NO "
              "final_record, NO write_experiment_record, NO commit_paths; run_test_evaluate raises TestAlreadyEvaluated "
              "(the test passes, pytest exit 0)",
              "remote after the fixture: exactly 3 commits, oldest first: marker only (A), result only (A), experiment "
              "record json + txt (A, Status PIPELINE_NOT_QUALIFIED, stop null); result.marker_commit = the marker commit",
              "work: test_details/ holds 16 files <model>_test.json; the clone is clean and at the remote's tip"]
    elif mode in AFTER_MARKER:
        exc = {"stop_after_marker": "ProtocolStop", "crash_after_marker": "RuntimeError",
               "interrupt_after_marker": "KeyboardInterrupt"}[mode]
        how = ("returns (False, 'BLOCKED'); the test fails at its own assertion (pytest exit 1)" if mode == "stop_after_marker"
               else "run_test_evaluate raises %s again (pytest exit %d)" % (exc, 1 if mode == "crash_after_marker" else 2))
        msg = ("message naming the injected stop" if mode == "stop_after_marker"
               else "message 'crash after the TEST marker: %s(...)'" % exc)
        keys = "['stopped', 'test_begun']" if mode == "stop_after_marker" else "['crashed', 'test_begun']"
        p += ["run 2: " + pre + "; " + begin_state + "; evaluate_model(split=test) entered 3 times, the 3rd raises the "
              "injected %s; 2 claims, 2 state hashes after begin; no finish; begun_by_this_process -> True; "
              "final_record('test-evaluate', 'BLOCKED', Actual keys %s with test_begun True, stop code None / status "
              "BLOCKED / %s); commit_paths [experiment record json, txt]; %s" % (exc, keys, msg, how),
              "remote after the fixture: exactly 2 commits: marker only, then experiment record json + txt; no result; "
              "the record's Status BLOCKED; the clone is clean and at the remote's tip; test_details/ 2 files"]
    else:
        p += ["run 2: check_preconditions, start_checks, the four records, the 15 checkpoint files, test_evaluation_seconds "
              "%.6f s, then my plugin raises Stop ST7 in place of before_run(%.6f); no base_model, no state hash, no begin, "
              "no evaluation; begun_by_this_process -> False; stop code ST7 -> final_record('test-evaluate', 'BLOCKED', "
              "Actual keys ['stopped', 'test_begun'] with test_begun False, stop code ST7 / status BLOCKED); commit_paths "
              "[experiment record json, txt]; returns (False, 'BLOCKED'); the test fails at looks[0] (pytest exit 1)" % (
                  MY_LOOKAHEAD, MY_LOOKAHEAD),
              "remote after the fixture: exactly 1 commit: experiment record json + txt (Status BLOCKED, stop ST7); no "
              "marker, no result; the clone is clean and at the remote's tip; no test_details/ files"]
    p += ["no added blob holds the synthetic TEST text %s; the result and the experiment records have no key starting "
          "with 'general_test' and no per-question / per-window row key %s; no TEST data file in the clone or the "
          "remote; this repository unchanged" % (list(TEXT_NEEDLES), sorted(ROW_KEYS))]
    return p


def runs_of(trace):
    out, cur = [], None
    for ev in trace:
        if ev["call"] == "run_test_evaluate" and ev["phase"] == "enter":
            cur = []
        elif ev["call"] == "run_test_evaluate" and cur is not None:
            out.append((cur, ev))
            cur = None
        elif cur is not None:
            cur.append(ev)
    if cur is not None:
        out.append((cur, None))
    return out


def calls(evs, name, phase="enter"):
    return [e for e in evs if e["call"] == name and e["phase"] == phase]


def idx(evs, pred):
    for i, e in enumerate(evs):
        if pred(e):
            return i
    return None


def before_begin(evs, n3_sha):
    """The pre-marker part of a run (events before begin's enter). Returns (dict of observations, index of begin)."""
    ib = idx(evs, lambda e: e["call"] == "begin_test_evaluation" and e["phase"] == "enter")
    pre = evs[:ib] if ib is not None else evs
    icp = idx(pre, lambda e: e["call"] == "check_preconditions" and e["phase"] == "return")
    own = pre[icp + 1:] if icp is not None else []      # test_evaluate's own reads: after check_preconditions returned
    reads_sorted = []
    for e in sorted(calls(own, "R.committed_record") + calls(own, "R.committed_json"), key=lambda e: e["seq"]):
        # record.committed_record calls record.committed_json: the nested read of the same path is the same read
        if not (e["call"] == "R.committed_json" and reads_sorted and reads_sorted[-1] == ("R.committed_record", e["rel"])):
            reads_sorted.append((e["call"], e["rel"]))
    reads_sorted = [rel for _, rel in reads_sorted]
    first_pt = idx(own, lambda e: e["call"] == "file_sha256" and e["phase"] == "enter")
    four = [r for r in reads_sorted if r in (FREEZE, GATE0, STEP2, STEP3)]
    i4 = [idx(own, lambda e, r=r: e["call"] in ("R.committed_record", "R.committed_json") and e["phase"] == "enter"
              and e["rel"] == r) for r in (FREEZE, GATE0, STEP2, STEP3)]
    tes = calls(pre, "test_evaluation_seconds", "return")
    tes_in = calls(pre, "test_evaluation_seconds")
    br = calls(pre, "p.before_run")
    sh = calls(pre, "T.state_sha256", "return")
    obs = {"check_preconditions": len(calls(pre, "check_preconditions")),
           "start_checks": [e["command"] for e in calls(pre, "Pilot.start_checks")],
           "four_records_read_in_order_before_the_checkpoint_loop": four == [FREEZE, GATE0, STEP2, STEP3]
           and None not in i4 and first_pt is not None and max(i4) < first_pt,
           "pt_hashes": sorted(e["file"] for e in calls(pre, "file_sha256")),
           "test_evaluation_seconds": [round(e["seconds"], 9) for e in tes],
           "timing_argument_is_the_fixture's": [e["timing"] == FIXTURE_TIMING for e in tes_in],
           "before_run": [round(e["next_seconds"], 9) for e in br],
           "base_model": len(calls(pre, "p.base_model")),
           "state_hashes_equal_step3_N": [e["sha256"] == n3_sha for e in sh]}
    return obs, ib


def run_end(end):
    if end is None:
        return None
    return (end["phase"], end.get("result") if end["phase"] == "return" else end.get("exc"))


def main():
    repo, py, inputs, scratch, mode = sys.argv[1:6]
    assert mode in MODES, mode
    ok = True
    if os.path.exists(scratch):
        print("scratch dir %s exists: refused" % scratch)
        return False
    os.makedirs(scratch)
    base, trace_f = os.path.join(scratch, "basetemp"), os.path.join(scratch, "trace.jsonl")
    tsrc = open(os.path.join(repo, "metrix/e1-pilot/tests/test_run_pilot.py"), encoding="utf-8").read()
    sel_line = 'SELECTED = {"F": "F3", "L": "L2", "A": "A5"}'
    timing_text = ('"preflight": {"timing": {"mean_step_s": 0.1, "a_factor": 1.0, "dev_evaluation_seconds": 1.0, "load_s": 1.0,\n'
                   '                                   "hash_s": 0.1, "save_s": 0.1, "reload_s": 0.1, "file_hash_s": 0.1}}')
    print("test file: SELECTED line present: %s | the fixture's step 2 timing text present: %s" % (
        sel_line in tsrc, timing_text in tsrc))
    ok &= sel_line in tsrc and timing_text in tsrc
    models = my_models()
    print("\n== my expectations (written before the run; mode %s)" % mode)
    for x in predictions(mode, models):
        print("  - " + x)
    sys.stdout.flush()

    st_args = ("status", "--porcelain", "--ignored", "--untracked-files=all", "--", "metrix",
               ":(exclude)metrix/e1-pilot/audit")
    gs_before = git(repo, *st_args)
    idx_before = git(repo, "ls-files", "-s")
    env = dict(os.environ, PYTHONPATH=os.path.join(repo, "metrix/e1-pilot/src") + os.pathsep
               + os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)), METRIX_INPUTS_DIR=inputs, IC9_TRACE=trace_f,
               IC9_FAULT="" if mode == "normal" else mode, PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE="1", GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS="0")
    cmd = [py, "-B", "-m", "pytest", "-q", "-p", "no:cacheprovider", "-p", "ic9_04_trace_plugin",
           "--basetemp=%s" % base, TEST_ID]
    print("\n== driver run (once): cwd %s" % repo)
    print("$ IC9_FAULT=%s " % env["IC9_FAULT"] + " ".join(shlex.quote(c) for c in cmd))
    print("----- pytest stdout+stderr begin -----")
    sys.stdout.flush()

sys.stdout.flush()
    t0 = time.time()
    r = subprocess.run(cmd, cwd=repo, env=env, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, text=True)
    print(r.stdout.rstrip("\n"))
    print("----- pytest stdout+stderr end ----- exit %d, %.0f s" % (r.returncode, time.time() - t0))
    want_rc = {"normal": 0, "interrupt_after_marker": 2}.get(mode, 1)
    print("pytest exit code %d, expected %d: %s" % (r.returncode, want_rc, r.returncode == want_rc))
    ok &= r.returncode == want_rc

    trace = [json.loads(x) for x in open(trace_f, encoding="utf-8").read().split("\n") if x]
    start = [e for e in trace if e["call"] == "test" and e["phase"] == "start"][0]
    print("\n== trace (%d events; events of the fixture before the test start omitted: %d)" % (
        len(trace), start["seq"] - 1))
    for e in trace:
        if e["seq"] >= start["seq"]:
            print("  " + json.dumps(e, ensure_ascii=False))
    root, remote, work, tip0, started = (start["root"], start["remote"], start["work"], start["remote_tip_after_fixture"],
                                         start["started"])
    EXP = [RES + "/experiment_record_test-evaluate_%s.json" % started, RES + "/experiment_record_test-evaluate_%s.txt" % started]
    print("\nfixture models as a set == my list: %s | fixture order: %s | Pilot start time %s -> experiment record %s | "
          "Pilot at the test start: begin_called %r marker_before_begin %r" % (
              sorted(start["models"]) == sorted(models), start["models"], started, EXP, start["begin_called"],
              start["marker_before_begin"]))
    ok &= sorted(start["models"]) == sorted(models) and start["models"][0] == "N"
    ok &= start["begin_called"] is False and start["marker_before_begin"] is None
    models = start["models"]
    step2 = json.loads(git(remote, "show", "%s:%s" % (tip0, STEP2)) or "{}")
    step3 = json.loads(git(remote, "show", "%s:%s" % (tip0, STEP3)) or "{}")
    n3 = (step3.get("N") or {}).get("state_sha256")
    print("remote at the fixture's tip: step 2 timing == the fixture's %s | step 3 N.state_sha256 %s" % (
        (step2.get("preflight") or {}).get("timing") == FIXTURE_TIMING, n3))
    ok &= (step2.get("preflight") or {}).get("timing") == FIXTURE_TIMING and n3 is not None
    runs = runs_of(trace)
    want_runs = 4 if mode == "normal" else 3
    print("run_test_evaluate calls: %d (expected %d)" % (len(runs), want_runs))
    ok &= len(runs) == want_runs
    if len(runs) != want_runs:
        return False
    la = round(MY_LOOKAHEAD, 9)
    want_pre = {"check_preconditions": 1, "start_checks": ["test-evaluate"],
                "four_records_read_in_order_before_the_checkpoint_loop": True,
                "pt_hashes": sorted(m + ".pt" for m in models[1:]), "test_evaluation_seconds": [la],
                "timing_argument_is_the_fixture's": [True], "before_run": [la], "base_model": 1,
                "state_hashes_equal_step3_N": [True]}

    def refusal(evs, end):
        obs, ib = before_begin(evs, n3)
        return dict(obs, begin=ib is not None,
                    evaluate_test=len([e for e in calls(evs, "evaluate_model") if e["split"] == "test"]),
                    begun_by_this_process=[e["result"] for e in calls(evs, "begun_by_this_process", "return")],
                    commit_paths=len(calls(evs, "commit_paths")), final_record=len(calls(evs, "final_record")),
                    end=run_end(end))

    print("\n== run 0 (base model not N's weights: refusal before the marker)")
    c0 = refusal(*runs[0])
    e0 = dict(want_pre, state_hashes_equal_step3_N=[False], begin=False, evaluate_test=0, begun_by_this_process=[False],
              commit_paths=0, final_record=0, end=("return", "(False, 'BLOCKED')"))
    print("observed %s\nexpected %s\nequal %s" % (c0, e0, c0 == e0))
    ok &= c0 == e0
    msg0 = [e.get("msg") for e in calls(runs[0][0], "test_evaluate", "raise")]
    print("test_evaluate raised: %s" % msg0)
    ok &= len(msg0) == 1 and "is not N's" in msg0[0] and "TEST not started" in msg0[0]

    print("\n== run 1 (changed checkpoint file: refusal before the marker)")
    c1 = refusal(*runs[1])
    e1 = {"check_preconditions": 1, "start_checks": ["test-evaluate"],
          "four_records_read_in_order_before_the_checkpoint_loop": True, "pt_hashes": [models[1] + ".pt"],
          "test_evaluation_seconds": [], "timing_argument_is_the_fixture's": [], "before_run": [], "base_model": 0,
          "state_hashes_equal_step3_N": [], "begin": False, "evaluate_test": 0, "begun_by_this_process": [False],
          "commit_paths": 0, "final_record": 0, "end": ("return", "(False, 'BLOCKED')")}
    print("observed %s\nexpected %s\nequal %s" % (c1, e1, c1 == e1))
    ok &= c1 == e1

    print("\n== run 2 (the evaluation run)")
    evs, end = runs[2]
    obs, i_begin = before_begin(evs, n3)

"""Orchestration of METRIX E1-PILOT: protocol v1.1 section 8, steps 1-8, run by metrix/e1-pilot/run_pilot.py.

Implementation Task Order V1 section 5 (run_pilot.py: steps 1-8 in order, ST12 before every step, the step's record
committed at its end), section 7 (smoke mode), section 11 (acceptance). Protocol sections 7 (search, selection,
training contract), 8 (steps; Gate 0; TEST), 10 (experiment record), 11 (stops). Review Gate's ruling on C1 of
2026-11-25 (tasks/IMPL_C1_RULING.md): item 3 (checkpoint hash = train.state_sha256; the smoke test saves and reloads
every checkpoint and shows the hash unchanged). Review Gate's ruling of 2026-11-27 (tasks/IMPL_C2_OWNER_MESSAGE.md): item
1 (TEST evaluation calls do not fetch; begin and finish do; nobody pushes to the pilot's branch between them).

Commands (run_pilot.py; every command prints RESULT: PASS / RESULT: FAIL, exit 0 only on PASS):
  smoke          steps 1-7 on the CPU with a random small model of the protocol's class (the pinned config.json
                 with fewer layers and a smaller width; no weight file is downloaded or loaded), STEPS optimizer steps
    checked out, the clone is not shallow, and HEAD is the latest commit of PILOT_BRANCH on the remote, fetched now
    (no tags; FETCH_HEAD and the remote-tracking ref are written). Returns that commit."""
    root = Path(repo_root)
    got = repo_id(remote_url(root, PILOT_REMOTE))
    if got != CANONICAL_REPO:
        raise _blocked("remote %s is repository %r, not the pilot's %r" % (PILOT_REMOTE, got, CANONICAL_REPO))
    local = _git(root, "rev-parse", "--abbrev-ref", "HEAD").stdout.strip()
    if local != PILOT_BRANCH:
        raise _blocked("the checked-out branch %r is not the pilot's %r" % (local, PILOT_BRANCH))
    if _git(root, "rev-parse", "--is-shallow-repository").stdout.strip() == "true":
        raise _blocked("the clone is shallow")
    f = _git(root, "fetch", "-q", "--no-tags", PILOT_REMOTE, "refs/heads/%s" % PILOT_BRANCH)
    if f.returncode != 0:
        raise _blocked("cannot fetch %s %s: %s" % (PILOT_REMOTE, PILOT_BRANCH, f.stderr.strip()))
    tip = _git(root, "rev-parse", "--verify", "-q", "FETCH_HEAD^{commit}").stdout.strip()
    head = _git(root, "rev-parse", "--verify", "-q", "HEAD^{commit}").stdout.strip()
    if not HEX40.fullmatch(tip) or head != tip:
        raise _blocked("HEAD %s is not the latest commit %r of %s %s: bring the checkout to it by a fast-forward "
                       "pull; a local commit made by a TEST path (ST10 record, TEST marker, TEST result) is pushed "
                       "only on the Owner's decision" % (head, tip, PILOT_REMOTE, PILOT_BRANCH))
    return tip


def _where(root, rel, tip):
    """Where `rel` exists (C1 ruling 1): the working tree, the file tree of `tip`."""
    found = ["working tree"] if (Path(root) / rel).exists() else []
    if _git(root, "cat-file", "-e", "%s:%s" % (tip, rel)).returncode == 0:
        found.append("commit %s" % tip)
    return found

import os

import ast
import subprocess
from ia_common import run

MUTS_FILES = {"metrix/e1-pilot/reports/impl_c/c2_mutate_fix2.py": 35, "metrix/e1-pilot/reports/impl_c/c2_mutate_fix2b.py": 1}
FILES = {"PI": "metrix/e1-pilot/src/metrix_e1/pilot.py", "RP": "metrix/e1-pilot/run_pilot.py"}


def staged(repo, rel):
    r = subprocess.run(["git", "-C", repo, "cat-file", "blob", ":" + rel], capture_output=True, env=dict(os.environ, GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS="0"))
    assert r.returncode == 0, rel
    return r.stdout.decode("utf-8")


def main():
    repo = sys.argv[1]
    ok = True
    blobs = {k: staged(repo, v) for k, v in FILES.items()}
    wt = {k: open(os.path.join(repo, v), encoding="utf-8").read() for k, v in FILES.items()}
    for k in FILES:
        print("%s: staged blob == working tree file: %s" % (FILES[k], blobs[k] == wt[k]))
        ok &= blobs[k] == wt[k]
    for mut, want_n in MUTS_FILES.items():
        tree = ast.parse(staged(repo, mut))
        muts = [n.value for n in tree.body if isinstance(n, ast.Assign) and [ast.unparse(t) for t in n.targets] == ["MUTS"]][0]
        print("\n%s" % mut)
        n = 0
        for t in muts.elts:
            name = t.elts[0].value
            path = ast.unparse(t.elts[1])
            old, new = t.elts[2], t.elts[3]
            assert isinstance(old, ast.Constant) and isinstance(old.value, str), name
            assert isinstance(new, ast.Constant) and isinstance(new.value, str), name
            c = blobs[path].count(old.value)
            c_new = blobs[path].count(new.value)
            c_new_in_old = old.value.count(new.value)
            n += 1
            new_ok = c_new == c_new_in_old * c or new.value in old.value or c_new == 0
            print("  %-66s %s: original occurs %d time(s) | replacement occurs %d (inside the original %d)%s" % (
                name, FILES[path].split("/")[-1], c, c_new, c_new_in_old * c,
                "" if new_ok else " -- replacement %r also occurs outside the original (informational)" % new.value))
            ok &= c == 1
        print("mutations read: %d (expected %d)" % (n, want_n))
        ok &= n == want_n
    return bool(ok)

def canon(obj):
    return json.dumps(obj, sort_keys=True, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(",", ":"), allow_nan=False).encode("utf-8")

def sha(b):

def file_sha(path):
    h = hashlib.sha256()

usage: python -I -B ic10_00_state.py <repo_root> <review_dir> <smoke_work_dir>"""
import os
import sys
sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
import re
import subprocess
from ia_common import sha, run

PARENT = "2665ab1036b66180ef1dee6b869135a45efefaa5"
TREE = "c7869d358c4adf6677d0f9843937bb6f3009b67b"
REC_TREE = "da82a1e1b4de13588bd215b1bf5b5e88bd001112"
CODE = ["metrix/e1-pilot/src", "metrix/e1-pilot/tests", "metrix/e1-pilot/run_pilot.py"]
IMPL_C = "metrix/e1-pilot/reports/impl_c/"
CODE_INPUT = ["metrix/e1-pilot/src", "metrix/e1-pilot/tests", IMPL_C + "c2_mutate_fix3.py", IMPL_C + "c2d_checks.sh"]
COPY = IMPL_C + "c2d_smoke_records/"
DRAFTS = ["metrix/e1-pilot/RUNBOOK_A100.md", IMPL_C + "c3_hf_tree_70d244cc.txt", IMPL_C + "c3_checks.sh"]
LS_RE = re.compile(r"^(100644|100755) ([0-9a-f]{40}) 0\t(metrix/e1-pilot/(?:src/|tests/|run_pilot\.py)\S*)$", re.M)
SUM_RE = re.compile(r"^([0-9a-f]{64})  (metrix/e1-pilot/reports/impl_c/(?:c2_mutate_fix3\.py|c2d_checks\.sh))$", re.M)


def g(repo, *a, text=True):

def ls_blocks(text):
    """The `git ls-files -s` code lines of a recording, grouped in runs of consecutive lines (one block per STATE)."""
    blocks, cur, last = [], [], None
    for m in LS_RE.finditer(text):
        line_no = text.count("\n", 0, m.start())
        if cur and line_no != last + 1:
            blocks.append(cur)
            cur = []
        cur.append((m.group(1), m.group(2), m.group(3)))
        last = line_no
    if cur:
        blocks.append(cur)
    return blocks


def tree_entries(repo, tree, *paths):

def main():

    listed = sorted((x.split("\t")[0].split()[0], x.split("\t")[0].split()[2], x.split("\t")[1]) for x in tt[2:] if x)
    tre = tree_entries(repo, TREE)
    print("   tree.txt listing %d entries == git ls-tree -r %s (%d): %s" % (len(listed), TREE[:8], len(tre), listed == tre))
    ok &= listed == tre
    idx = sorted(tuple(x.split("\t")[0].split()[:2] + [x.split("\t")[1]]) for x in g(repo, "ls-files", "-s").stdout.split("\n") if x)
    print("   index entries %d | tree %s entries %d | identical (mode, blob, path): %s" % (len(idx), TREE[:8], len(tre), idx == tre))
    ok &= idx == tre

        len(diff), sha(diff), len(inp), tail))

        ok &= kinds == ["A"] and not not_evidence and rc == staged_code
    else:

    same, diffr, missing = 0, [], []
    for rel in copies:
        sub = rel[len(COPY):]
        src = os.path.join(work, "records", sub)
        staged = g(repo, "cat-file", "blob", ":" + rel, text=False).stdout
        if not os.path.exists(src):
            missing.append(sub)
            continue
        if open(src, "rb").read() == staged:
            same += 1
        else:
            diffr.append(sub)
    print("\nd. staged copies under %s: %d | byte-identical to %s/records: %d | different %s | not in the smoke's records %s" % (
        COPY, len(copies), work, same, diffr, missing))
    lab = os.path.join(repo, COPY + "LABEL.txt")
    print("   LABEL.txt of the copy directory: %r" % open(lab, encoding="utf-8").read())
    ok &= not diffr and missing == ["LABEL.txt"] and same == len(copies) - 1
    smoke_recs = sorted(os.path.relpath(os.path.join(d, f), os.path.join(work, "records"))
                        for d, _, fs in os.walk(os.path.join(work, "records")) for f in fs)
    not_copied = sorted(set(smoke_recs) - {c[len(COPY):] for c in copies})
    print("   smoke records not copied (expected: the per-question details only): %d, all under details/: %s" % (
        len(not_copied), all(x.startswith("details/") for x in not_copied)))
    ok &= all(x.startswith("details/") for x in not_copied)

    for d in DRAFTS:
        st = [x for x in g(repo, "status", "--porcelain", "--", d).stdout.split("\n") if x]
        in_idx = g(repo, "cat-file", "-e", ":" + d).returncode == 0
        print("\ne. %s status %s | in the index %s (expected untracked '??', not staged)" % (d, st, in_idx))
        ok &= st == ["?? " + d] and not in_idx

    print("\nf. first lines of the recordings and their HEAD lines")
    for f, t in texts.items():
        first = t.split("\n")[0]
        m = re.search(r"parent ([0-9a-f]+)", first)
        heads = [x for x in re.findall(r"^([0-9a-f]{40})$", t, re.M) if x == PARENT]
        print("   %s: first line names parent %r (prefix of the real parent: %s) | `git rev-parse HEAD` lines equal to %s: %d" % (
            f, m.group(1) if m else None, bool(m) and PARENT.startswith(m.group(1)), PARENT[:12], len(heads)))
    sh = open(os.path.join(repo, IMPL_C, "c2d_checks.sh"), encoding="utf-8").read().split("\n")
    print("   c2d_checks.sh line 9 names %r" % re.findall(r"parent [0-9a-f]+", sh[8]))
    return bool(ok)

def preflight(p):
    """Section 8 step 2 (ST11; B17 plus the checkpoint overhead, see the module docstring): the first configuration
    for the protocol's preflight steps (formal: preflight mode on the A100; smoke: smoke mode on the CPU, its numbers
    are smoke values). Its outputs are timing only."""
    pmode = M.preflight_mode(p.contract) if p.mode.formal else p.mode
    spec = T.search_runs(p.contract, "F")[0]
    p.before_run()
    t0 = time.perf_counter()
    model = p.base_model()
    load_s = time.perf_counter() - t0
    try:
        res = T.train_run(model, p.tok, p.rows, spec, p.contract, pmode, p.device)
        summ = CP.preflight_summary(res.log, p.device)
        t0 = time.perf_counter()
        E.evaluate_model(model, p.tok, p.rows, p.fz.templates, p.contract.evaluation, pmode, p.device, split="dev")
        eval_s = time.perf_counter() - t0
    except T.NonFinite as e:            # no estimate, so no ST11 judgement: stopped as for a control (ST6)
        STP.st6(p.fz, e.values or [float("nan")], "preflight %s: %s" % (spec.name, e), True)
        raise
    t0 = time.perf_counter()
    T.state_sha256(model)
    hash_s = time.perf_counter() - t0
    d = p.work / PREFLIGHT_DIR
    p.label_dir(d)
    path = d / "preflight_checkpoint.pt"
    t0 = time.perf_counter()
    torch.save({"label": pmode.label, "state_dict": model.state_dict()}, path)
    save_s = time.perf_counter() - t0
    t0 = time.perf_counter()
    FZ.file_sha256(path)
    file_hash_s = time.perf_counter() - t0
    del model
    gc.collect()
    t0 = time.perf_counter()
    fresh = p.base_model()
    fresh.load_state_dict(torch.load(path, map_location=p.device, weights_only=True)["state_dict"], strict=True)
    reload_s = time.perf_counter() - t0
    del fresh
    gc.collect()
    anchors = [r["ids"] for r in p.rows[T.ANCHOR_FILE]]
    steps = list(T.step_numbers(p.contract.training.total_steps))
    anchor_per_step = sum(sum(len(anchors[i]) for i in T.anchor_docs(s, p.contract.arms)) for s in steps) / len(steps)
    fact_per_step = sum(e["fact_tokens"] for e in res.log) / len(res.log)
    used = p.clock.used() if p.clock is not None else 0.0
    hours, parts = CP.estimate_total_hours(p.contract, summ["mean_seconds_per_step_excluding_first"], fact_per_step,
                                           anchor_per_step, eval_s, used)
    overhead, counts = checkpoint_overhead_seconds(p.contract, load_s, hash_s, save_s, reload_s, file_hash_s)
    p.pre = {"mean_step_s": summ["mean_seconds_per_step_excluding_first"], "a_factor": parts["a_factor"],
             "dev_evaluation_seconds": eval_s, "load_s": load_s, "hash_s": hash_s, "save_s": save_s,
             "reload_s": reload_s, "file_hash_s": file_hash_s}
    out = {"label": pmode.label, "mode": pmode.name, "run": spec.name, "steps": res.steps_run, "summary": summ,

           "b17_plus_checkpoint_overhead_hours_report_only": hours + overhead / 3600.0,
           "timing": p.pre, "checkpoint_file": str(path), "_files": [path]}
    p.log("preflight (%s): %.4f s/step, DEV evaluation %.1f s, B17 estimate %.3f h (ST11); checkpoint overhead %.3f h "

                                        hours + overhead / 3600.0))
    return out

_LIVE = {}                  # session_id -> TestSession, only those returned by begin_test_evaluation in this process


def begin_test_evaluation(fz, authorization, data, base_model_sha256, repo_root=None, retries=4, sleep=None):
    """Start the single TEST evaluation (Review Gate supplementary ruling 4): checks (no marker or result:
    refuse_if_marker; the authorization; the ST10 gate for the TEST rows in `data`; check_commit_preconditions),
    writes the marker with every checkpoint hash of the committed freeze record plus N (`base_model_sha256`,
    train.state_sha256 of the loaded base model), commits only the marker and pushes it. Returns the TestSession."""
    from . import contract as C
    root = Path(repo_root) if repo_root is not None else fz.repo_root
    refuse_if_marker(root)
    recs = LK.verify_authorization(authorization, fz, root)
    rows_hashes = rows_hashes_of(data)
    st10_sha, aud_sha = st10_check(fz, authorization, rows_hashes, root)
    if not isinstance(base_model_sha256, str) or not FZ.HEX64.fullmatch(base_model_sha256):
        raise _refuse("base model hash %r" % (base_model_sha256,))
    freeze = recs["selection_freeze"]
    checkpoints = dict(freeze["checkpoints"], **{BASE_MODEL: base_model_sha256})
    models = evaluated_models(C.load(fz), freeze["selected"])
    check_commit_preconditions(root, "the TEST marker")
    session_id = secrets.token_hex(16)
    marker = {"kind": "test_evaluation_marker", "mode": "formal", "frozen_commit": authorization.frozen_commit,
              "authorization": auth_fields(authorization), "remote": remote_url(root, PILOT_REMOTE),
              "branch": PILOT_BRANCH, "st10_record_sha256": st10_sha, "auditor_count_sha256": aud_sha,
              "test_files_sha256": rows_hashes, "checkpoints": checkpoints, "models": models,
              "code_commit": code_commit(root), "session_id": session_id,
              "started_utc": time.strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ", time.gmtime())}
    path = root / MARKER_REL
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    blob = (json.dumps(marker, ensure_ascii=False, indent=1, sort_keys=True) + "\n").encode("utf-8")
    path.write_bytes(blob)
    head = commit_paths(root, [MARKER_REL], "metrix: E1-PILOT TEST evaluation marker (section 8 step 8: TEST is "
                        "evaluated once; every checkpoint hash)",
                        "the TEST marker (TEST not evaluated; the marker refuses any later evaluation)", retries, sleep)
    if _blob(root, "%s:%s" % (head, MARKER_REL)) != blob or _blob(root, "%s^:%s" % (head, MARKER_REL)) is not None:
        raise _blocked("the pushed commit %s does not hold this TEST marker alone (another TEST evaluation began at "
                       "the same time): it counts as evaluated; no TEST evaluation in this process" % head)
    session = TestSession(session_id, head)
    _LIVE[session_id] = session
    return session


def _check_session_checkout(root, session):
    """PILOT_BRANCH is checked out at the session's marker commit (no fetch: see the module docstring). So the
    committed marker, Gate 0, freeze and ST10 records are the ones begin_test_evaluation checked and wrote."""
    local = _git(root, "rev-parse", "--abbrev-ref", "HEAD").stdout.strip()
def refuse_if_st10_record(repo_root):
    """TEST is generated once: refused when an ST10 record exists (the working tree, the file tree of the remote
    branch's latest commit; check_checkout first). The TEST driver calls this before it generates anything."""
    root = Path(repo_root)
    where = _where(root, ST10_RECORD_REL, check_checkout(root))
    if where:
        raise ImplementationFail("%s exists (%s): TEST is generated once" % (ST10_RECORD_REL, ", ".join(where)))

def _traced(name, fn):
    def wrapper(*a, **k):
        info = {"call": "p." + name, "phase": "enter"}
        if name == "before_run":
            info["next_seconds"] = a[0] if a else k.get("next_seconds", 0.0)
            if (FAULT == "st7_before_begin" and not _STATE["st7_done"] and _STATE["rte_calls"] == 3
                    and info["next_seconds"] > 0):
                _STATE["st7_done"] = True
                from metrix_e1 import stops as STP
                exc = STP.Stop("ST7", "BLOCKED", "stop and report", "auditor-injected ST7 look-ahead before the TEST "
                               "begin (ic10 fault injection, next_seconds %r)" % info["next_seconds"])
                _log(dict(info, phase="injected", fault=FAULT, exc=type(exc).__name__))
                raise exc
        _log(info)
        try:
            r = fn(*a, **k)
        except BaseException as e:      # noqa: B902 -- logged and re-raised unchanged

            raise
        _log({"call": "p." + name, "phase": "return"})
        return r
    wrapper.__ic10_traced__ = True
    return wrapper

    def model_for(self, spec):
        """A fresh model of the run's structure (arm L: LoRA applied, train.prepare_arm) with the base weights."""
        m = self.base_model()
        if spec.arm == "L":
            T.prepare_arm(m, spec, self.contract, self.mode)
        return m

    def save_checkpoint(self, spec, model):
        """B25 / C1 ruling 3: state_sha256 of the trained model; torch.save; reload into a fresh model of the run's
        structure; state_sha256 again, equal or IMPLEMENTATION_FAIL. Returns (reloaded model, checkpoint info)."""
        self.label_dir(self.ckpt_dir)
        t0 = time.perf_counter()
        sha = T.state_sha256(model)
        t1 = time.perf_counter()
        path = self.ckpt_dir / ("%s.pt" % spec.name)
        if path.exists():
            raise ImplementationFail("checkpoint %s exists: each run is trained once" % path)
        torch.save({"label": self.mode.label, "run": spec.name, "state_sha256": sha, "state_dict": model.state_dict()},
                   path)
        t2 = time.perf_counter()
        reloaded = self.load_checkpoint(spec, path)     # the caller still holds `model` (80 GB hold both)
        t3 = time.perf_counter()
        again = T.state_sha256(reloaded)
        t4 = time.perf_counter()
        if again != sha:
            raise ImplementationFail("%s: state sha256 %s after saving and reloading, %s before" % (spec.name, again, sha))
        info = {"state_sha256": sha, "reloaded_state_sha256": again, "file": path.name,
                "file_sha256": FZ.file_sha256(path), "file_bytes": path.stat().st_size,
                "seconds": {"hash": t1 - t0, "save": t2 - t1, "reload": t3 - t2, "hash_after_reload": t4 - t3}}
        return reloaded, info

def final_record(p, command, status, actual, nxt, runs, stop):
    """Write the experiment record; formal: commit and push it. A failing commit or push leaves it in the working
    tree (reported; the Owner decides) and is re-raised only when the run itself did not stop.
    A formal run that stopped before step 1 began (the device check ST8, the code not committed, the commit
    preconditions of step 1) did not start on this machine: its record is written to <work>, outside the repository,
    and nothing is committed (no formal command writes into or pushes from a clone on a machine that is not the
    pilot's); the operator reports it with the log (RUNBOOK_A100.md section 4). This includes ST8 on the A100 host
    (e.g. a 40 GB card), ST12 or ST13 at the start of step 1, the continuity checks (start_checks), and ST12 in
    Pilot() itself (no Pilot, so no record at all: run_pilot.py exits with the traceback). Whether such a record
    belongs in the repository is for Review Gate (protocol section 10; reports/IMPL_C_REPORT.md).
    Records written by the run and not yet committed (a stop or crash inside a step) are committed with it."""
    if p.mode.formal and command == "formal" and not p.step1_started:
        paths = write_experiment_record(p, command, status, actual, nxt, runs, stop, outside_repo=True)
        p.log("experiment record: %s (status %s; the run stopped before step 1: not committed)" % (paths[0], status))
        return paths
    paths = write_experiment_record(p, command, status, actual, nxt, runs, stop)
    p.log("experiment record: %s (status %s)" % (paths[0], status))
    try:
        p.precommit("the experiment record")
        left = [x for x in p.uncommitted if x not in paths]
        p.commit(left + paths, "metrix: E1-PILOT formal %s experiment record (status %s)%s" % (
            command, status, "; %d records of the stopped step" % len(left) if left else ""), "the experiment record")
    except ProtocolStop as e:
        p.log("the experiment record was not committed: %s; it stays in the working tree; report to the Owner" % e)
        if stop is None:
            raise
    return paths
